# `pitchfork supervisor run`

- **Usage:** `pitchfork supervisor run [FLAGS]`

Runs the internal pitchfork daemon in the foreground

## Flags
- **`-f --force`** — kill existing daemon
- **`--boot`** — run as boot start (auto-start boot_start daemons)
- **`--container`** — Enable container/PID1 mode (reap zombies, forward signals)

  **Environment Variable:** `PITCHFORK_CONTAINER`
- **`--web-port <WEB_PORT>`** — Enable web UI on specified port (tries up to 10 ports if in use)

  **Environment Variable:** `PITCHFORK_WEB_PORT`
- **`--web-path <WEB_PATH>`** — Serve web UI under a path prefix (e.g. "ps" serves at /ps/)

  **Environment Variable:** `PITCHFORK_WEB_PATH`
- **`-h --help`** — Print help
